sumber: NVD (deskripsi otoritatif) + support.plesk.com KB (rentang patch vendor) + docs.plesk.com release notes + OpenCVE
catatan: Urutan kepercayaan: (1) NVD/CNA utk DESKRIPSI & identitas CVE, (2) tabel 'Affected/Patched versions' di KB Plesk utk RENTANG, (3) aggregator AI (OpenCVE/Strix) HANYA pelengkap - terbukti saling bertentangan. Field dasar: tercatat = dikutip langsung; inferensi = diturunkan dari rentang; komponen = celah di Apache/nginx yg dibundel Plesk, bukan Plesk inti.

advisories.judul: LPE via OS command injection - customer/reseller dgn shell access -> root
advisories.catatan: Tabel vendor: Plesk for Linux 18.0.34-18.0.79.8 & 18.0.80-18.0.80.4; patched 18.0.79.9 / 18.0.80.5. Windows tidak terdampak.

advisories.judul: Path traversal - local user execute arbitrary code as root
advisories.catatan: NVD: '18.0.79.9 and earlier and 18.0.80 through 18.0.80.5' -> patch pertama 18.0.80.6.

advisories.judul: Backup Manager TOCTOU symlink race -> ownership takeover -> root
advisories.catatan: Affects 18.0.80.6 ke bawah & 18.0.79.10 ke bawah, Linux saja. Patch 18.0.80.7 / 18.0.79.11. Perlu akses panel + FTP subscription sendiri.

advisories.judul: Incorrect database cloning - RCE atas nama DB server administrator
advisories.catatan: NVD: 'from 18.0.52 before 18.0.79.6 and 18.0.80.2'. KOREKSI: kueri awalku salah menempelkan deskripsi ini ke CVE-2026-44962.

advisories.judul: IDOR - baca & ubah database pelanggan lain (remote, authenticated)
advisories.catatan: NVD: '18.0.79.7 and earlier or 18.0.80 through 18.0.80.3' -> patch 18.0.80.4. KOREKSI: awalnya tertukar dgn CVE-2026-64639.

advisories.judul: XML-RPC API improper privilege mgmt - reseller -> session root
advisories.catatan: NVD/CNA semver [0, 18.0.80.1) -> 18.0.80.0 MASIH terdampak. CVSS 9.9, CWE-269. Plesk KB: 'Authentication Bypass Leading to Privilege Escalation'.

advisories.judul: SQL injection - authenticated user baca arbitrary dari panel database
advisories.catatan: NVD: 'up to 18.0.80'. Angka patch 18.0.80.1 DITURUNKAN dari frasa itu (bukan dikutip). CVSS 7.7. Catatan: OpenCVE pernah mendeskripsikan CVE ini sbg 'XML API file write' - keliru, milik CVE-2026-48614.

advisories.judul: XML API improper authorization -> inject direktif konfigurasi -> file write root
advisories.catatan: CNA: affected < 18.0.78, CVSS 9.9, CWE-94. PALING RELEVAN dgn pengujian XML API. Sudah PATCHED di 18.0.80. Sempat salah kaitkan ke CVE-2026-64636/64637 oleh aggregator.

advisories.judul: Blind SQL injection di XML-RPC API -> baca seluruh DB Plesk
advisories.catatan: Tabel vendor: 'All versions below 18.0.79.4', Linux & Windows. CVSS 9.9. Mitigasi sementara: panel.ini [api] deprecationError = on. Sudah PATCHED di 18.0.80.

advisories.judul: XPath injection di APS Application Catalog search
advisories.catatan: NVD: published 2026-05-29, deskripsi XPath injection. Rentang versi TIDAK ada di NVD (belum di-enrich) dan belum kutemukan di KB -> DATA_KURANG. KOREKSI: kueri awal salah menempelkan deskripsi 'database cloning' ke sini.

advisories.judul: Improper symlink resolution sebelum file access -> RCE root (remote, authenticated)
advisories.catatan: NVD: published 2026-08-26. Rentang versi belum ada di NVD -> DATA_KURANG.

advisories.judul: DNS zone management - disclose arbitrary local file + privilege escalation
advisories.catatan: 2026-09-11, remote authenticated. Rentang versi belum tercatat -> DATA_KURANG.

advisories.judul: Backup Manager path traversal -> arbitrary file write as root (authenticated customer)
Double Free + possible RCE di Apache HTTP Server modul HTTP/2
advisories.catatan: Ini celah APACHE, bukan Plesk inti - relevan karena Plesk membundel Apache. Rentang: 2.4.x sebelum patch vendor. Verifikasi versi Apache di server.

NVD rentang salah satu cabang: nginx 0.6.27 - 1.30.0 (end inclusive). Changelog Plesk 18.0.80 Update 9 menaikkan nginx ke 1.30.5 -> kemungkinan PATCHED, tapi tergantung patch distro. Verifikasi `nginx -v`.

advisories.judul: DoS via get_password.php (unauthenticated, web interface terus reload)
advisories.catatan: NVD configurations: versionEndExcluding 18.0.73 (mulai 8.0.1). CVSS 7.5. Sudah PATCHED lama sebelum 18.0.80. Catatan kecil: deskripsi NVD menulis 'through 18.0.73' - beda 1 patch level dari rentang CPE-nya.

advisories.judul: 18.0.81 + 18.0.81 Update 2: critical security issue (CVE belum dipublikasikan)
advisories.catatan: Changelog 15 Sep & 29 Sep 2026 menyebut critical fix di 18.0.81 yang TIDAK ada di 18.0.80. Placeholder - GANTI id ini begitu nomor CVE resmi terbit (fetch NVD ulang saat itu).
